Complete [[Divinity Coast]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
*Deliver the [[Eye of Janthir]] to [[Loamhurst]].
* *BONUS* Find and deliver five [[Chosen]] to Loamhurst.
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 500 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 20 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 30 Zaishen Copper Coins.
* Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
As per the [[Divinity Coast]] mission.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Zaishen Mission
:''"Strong, reliable guards are needed to collect the Eye of Janthir and conduct this holiest of items through [[Divinity Coast (outpost)|Divinity Coast]]. Seek [[Justiciar Hablion]] in [[Shaemoor]] to apply."''
{{offer dialogue
|accept = I can do that!
|decline = No, I'm way too busy today.
|ask = The battle rages on! All able-bodied heroes should hasten to defend those bravely protecting [[Tyria (world)|Tyria]]. }}

===Reward dialogue===
;Zehnchu
:''"Excellent work! The Zaishen admire your dedication."''

== Notes ==
* It might be easier to complete the first bonus objective in [[normal mode]], since the five Chosen can die more quickly in [[hard mode]].
